claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins: one fresh 64-bit coin opens the run with probability K/2^64, K = 7204349127034276673, the least integer with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39, lo_run the exact opened-run lower bound of success.md 6.5 (Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs, conditioning on points; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry and weak-operand sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows). Its expected total work is at most 2^123.630897608515937 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit), 2^7 + (K/2^64) E_run, with an opened run's work at most 82.6044 per leaf E-averaged over 780 groups of 688296 Y-batches (q1 = 536870880) that stop at the first resolving group, every walk, key path, main-pair K2 verification and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^190.490444 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^72 nodes keeps 1024 permanent points X with 5120 one-TiB lookup tables (tbld8, charged) and generates each batch's 2^15 points Y = C + [m t + n s]P (m < 8192, n < 4) with one shared inverse per step (ygen, charged); six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per incidence come from one batched inverse per pair of X's (fwd 76.63 and bwd 1138.69 instructions per incidence by LD64B table lookups) and are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products (sections 3.1-3.3); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code, with FEAT_LS64 at the locations of section 2.1, DC ZVA on 256-byte blocks (DCZID_EL0.BS = 6) and the per-processor finite receive aperture of section 2.1. New against the 480-group package, same q1: 780 groups of 688296, ecopy at group 391, phase control 318241, barriers 13265. Feasible split, not a minimum over partitions. Kernels unchanged. Peak memory at most 2^135.9994 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.2614 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure and every ledger row. Built on af8409e4 (lineage 401bac48, fe33fff4, ad9027be, de987687), kaankolcu's p256 run gate 1e5413b0, aburan28's dd4f2b0a rectangle and soispoke's flipped grid, X-pair partial fractions, u/v split and lookups (7f4f73d0, 17a007c8), credited in proof.md section 9; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Flip kernels (fwd, bwd, keys) on production points against bit-exact models (fractions, bounds, Fourier identity, records, indices, labels), ygen's Y-records and tbld8's tables against exact references, the 3.4 sites, weak operands and fixups (sites.py), both hops and the join on a 4 x 4 machine with LS64/ISA failing tests (machine.py), every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
